items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: the records that I made with Ray Badouk, I think, on drums

ctx.x: Do you want to go back and play? Left off, let's see, we're talking about ragtime, this was kind of shifted a bit. You made many recordings in the past years. Do you have any sessions that you would point out to as being your favorite or your better sessions that you feel are more representative of your playing?

Yeah, the sessions that I made that are better representative are on Golden Crest label with, it's under the title of Rags and Blues. And then, of course, the records that I made with Ray Badouk, I think, on drums, that was just drum and piano solos, you know, when I made Little Rock Getaway. I made an album on Circle back in 1950 that was very good, technically, you know, I mean, from a recording standpoint and all.
Have you ever recorded anything which shows the broader scope of your playing? I just heard you're playing, was it, was it that Melchor May tune, was it? What were you just doing?
